Union Tool.why: PCB drill maker whose ULF-coated drills are used to drill package substrates; demand for package substrates for data center servers drives its sales, so its stock benefits from AI package-substrate build-out
Union Tool.evidence: Union Tool H1 FY2026 analyst meeting material: 'Demand for semiconductor packages (PKGs) is increasing due to generative AI, and our ULF-coated drills are used in drilling processes for package substrates.'

players.product: PCB drills, incl. ULF-coated drills used to drill semiconductor package substrates, and long-flute drills

quarterly_data.quarter: Union Tool analyst meeting material: Financial Results for the First Half of FY2026 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: demand for high-end PCB drills is growing rapidly, supported by expansion in the generative AI market, and capital investment is being increased to expand production capacity. Construction of Factory No. 6 at the Nagaoka Plant is scheduled for completion in June 2027 (planned investment approx. JPY 6,200 million). FY2026 cash allocation plan: capital investment 18,200 million yen and R&D 2,300 million yen, to expand supply capacity for ULF-coated drills and long-flute drills through the rapid startup of in-house equipment.
quarterly_data.figure: Nagaoka Factory No. 6: approx. JPY 6,200 million, completion June 2027; FY2026 capital investment 18,200 million yen

quarterly_data.quarter: Union Tool analyst meeting material: Financial Results for the First Half of FY2026 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: demand for semiconductor packages is increasing due to generative AI, and its ULF-coated drills are used in drilling processes for package substrates. ULF-coated products were 36.9% of PCB drill sales in FY26.6 (35.0% in FY25). PCB drill sales were ¥20,183 million in H1 FY2026 (¥29,026 million in full-year FY2025).
quarterly_data.figure: ULF-coated share of PCB drill sales 36.9%; PCB drill sales ¥20,183 million (H1 FY2026)
